notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: Warden of the Eye is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker. It triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye that's tapped and attacking.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn
